messages:
Maya: quick check — where are we on the console telemetry cutover? need a short list of remaining blockers and owners so PMs can update the milestone.
Raj: my team finished the dashboard widgets, but we still need the tracing hook names from runtime before we wire alerts. pinging @Olga for the hook mapping.
Olga: working on that mapping now. PR is up: `github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/482` — it adds `trace.context_id` and `svc.latency_ms`. still TODO: small rename to keep schema stable.
Sam: fyi we saw a spike in envelopes during the last deploy; if retention cutover reduces sample rate we might miss regression signals. can we keep 10% sample flagged for the first 48h?
Maya: good call. let's make that an explicit fallback policy. owner: Raj to flip the sample flag, Olga to confirm data keys, Sam to watch SLOs.
Raj: I can add the feature toggle in console-config. snippet: `featureToggles.telemetry_sampling = { default: 0.1, override: {} }` — will open a small PR and link here. ETA EOD today.
Olga: renamed field in the PR to `trace.session_id` (keeps parity with mobile). will push a follow-up commit with compat logic.
Sam: I'll create an alert: `sum(rate(errors[5m])) by (route) > 0.05` and a dashboard panel for latency regressions; will tag it `obs-cutover-watch`.
Maya: milestone asks: retention policy switch on 2026-04-01; remaining items: (1) Raj PR to set sampling toggle, (2) Olga finalize hook mapping + compat, (3) Sam alerts + runbook. Are we missing any infra deps?
Raj: infra note — Dedicated infra needs a new k8s env var `OBS_RETENTION_MODE` set before cutover. I'll coordinate with infra on Tuesday morning.
Olga: compatibility note: older model of logs sends `trace_id` as int; my PR casts to string. will document in the migration notes in the PR.
Maya: ok assign owners in the milestone board. I'll update the milestone and tag the stakeholders. thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary deploy `console-telemetry-v2` succeeded in us-west-2 (3/3 healthy)
Raj: pushing PR now — link: `github.com/redwood/console/pulls/999`
Sam: starting a 48h watch window once the toggle lands. putting it on my calendar.
Maya: if anyone hits blockers, drop a quick ping here and we'll escalate. otherwise I'll send a short summary to product ops after Raj's PR merges.
Olga: noted, I'll post the mapping doc to the milestone board when ready.
Maya: thanks — that will unblock the rollout.
